name: carousel-26
description: What's new modal-style card cycling through release notes with version badges.

files.content:
import { Gift as GiftIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, } from "@workspace/ui/components/card" import { Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselNext, CarouselPrevious, } from "@workspace/ui/components/carousel" const releases = [ { version: "v3.2", date: "Nov 4", title: "460+ blocks", body: "New analytics, auth and pricing blocks on designali.com/blocks.", }, { version: "v3.1", date: "Oct 18", title: "4000+ icons", body: "@designali/icons now covers every UI example on the site.", }, { version: "v3.0", date: "Sep 30", title: "Logos package", body: "Install @designali/logos for Github, Vercel, Figma and more.", }, ] export default function ReleaseNotesCarousel() { return ( What's new {releases.map((release) => (
{release.version} {release.date}

{release.title}

{release.body}

))}
) }
